proposed_facts.justification: BFS09 Theorem6 with c=1 implies NEXP is not contained in Theta2P. If NE were contained in Theta2P, pad any NEXP language with exponent k to an injectively encoded length p(n)=(n+2)^k. The padded language is in NE. A polynomial-time Theta2P decider for it composes with padding in polynomial time and uses O(log p(n))=O(log n) NP queries. Hence NEXP would be contained in Theta2P, a contradiction. Ignore the allowed advice in BFS09; do not replace the fixed query exponent by an arbitrary union.

Independent redundant derivation: NP subset NE subset coNP would imply NP subset coNP and, by complement, coNP subset NP. Thus NE subset NP, contrary to the nondeterministic time hierarchy. This checks six consequences without relying on the sharper query lower bound.

proposed_rules.justification: Theorem1 and its explicit FewP special case give AM=SBP if 3-SAT is in FewP. NP subset FewP supplies that hypothesis. The reverse inclusion SBP subset AM is already known; the UP premise is subsumed by UP subset FewP.

Chakaravarthy–Roy give PH=O2P under NP subset P/poly; O2P subset P/poly by hardwiring the lengthwise winning witnesses. Independent elementary derivation: the premise gives NP/poly=P/poly; at each fixed PH level, hardwire polynomial-size circuits for the NP oracle at all polynomially many possible query lengths, obtaining NP/poly=P/poly. The polynomial degree may depend on the language/level.

closure_check.method: Benchmark.closure with one temporary NE-not-subset-Theta2P assumption on the bound dataset; compare exact Atom keys
closure_check.result: Eight new separation labels, no new inclusion and no contradiction

operational_semantics_review.finding: Fair binary transitions and terminal padding; all paths halt within a polynomial bound. An arbitrary polynomially bounded runtime budget does not create advice when it only chooses additional terminal padding.

Concrete deterministic verifiers; finite-polynomial witness and coin lengths; MA witness before coins and AM counts coins admitting a witness. Advice in NPpoly is intentionally arbitrary by input length. All inputs satisfy the total-language gap.
Concrete oracle tapes and counts; Theta2P bounds NP calls by c times (log2(n+1)+1); PH union uses a fixed finite level per language.

Concrete uniform samplers retain output multiplicities and compare statistical distance by exact integer cross-multiplication. The far/close thresholds implement the standard total Statistical Difference characterization; equivalence to every textbook model remains unproved.

rules: E subset C implies EXP subset C
NE subset C implies NEXP subset C
padding_cross_review.method: For each fixed language exponent use explicit injective polynomial padding of length (n+2)^k, then closure under deterministic polynomial-time many-one preimages. Polynomial witnesses and randomness, finite PH level, and logarithmic NP-query count are preserved. Zero-error expected-time/truncated-Las-Vegas equivalence is standard but not proved here.
padding_cross_review.restriction: This does not approve padding that preserves a fixed n^c resource bound with the same c. Quantum, circuit, and counting targets belong to other reviewers.

unresolved_risk_estimate.unit: Incorrect ordered-pair labels in this scope after the eight corrections; excludes future-discovered flaws in currently accepted proofs
unresolved_risk_estimate.status: Subjective sensitivity elicitation, not a calibrated posterior or a certified upper bound
unresolved_risk_estimate.probability_interpretation: Chance at least one still-missed pre-cutoff issue of the stated type affects this scope, conditional on this limited pass. Fanout is a conditional expected affected-pair count, not an observed maximum. Ranges are judgment inputs for cross-review; no independence assumption is made.

clusters.grounds: One omitted theorem in this pass changed eight labels. Standard inclusion diagrams and all nineteen entries did not expose the query-bound separation, so a full-entry census is weak evidence against another such omission.

Primary SBP/SZK and oblivious-alternation papers plus the full entries supplied no other unconditional edge, but promise and operator variants are numerous; another edge could propagate to several supersets.

All four relevant concrete modules were read, and obvious promise/advice/quantifier traps were checked. The ordinary class-model equivalence proofs remain absent; a shared semantic mismatch could affect many pairs. This excludes a later-discovered flaw in an accepted mathematical proof.

Selective ECCC, arXiv, journal and 2026 proceedings follow-up found no relevant new pair theorem; it was not a complete publication census. A broad collapse or simulation would have correlated effects.

unresolved_risk_estimate.aggregation_warning: Clusters can overlap, so this is conservative sensitivity accounting rather than an exact expectation interval. Other agents overlap this pair scope; their estimates must not simply be added. The low endpoint does not establish the user stopping rule.

next_pass_requests: Independent reproduction of the NE/Theta2P padding derivation and all eight propagated labels, using the primary fixed-query theorem.
Cross-review the two new conditional rules and existing total-language MA/BPP rules for hidden promise assumptions.
Second reviewer to inspect the source interpretations and exact operational definitions; do not treat repeated AI agreement as independent expert evidence.
Concentrate remaining historical search on bounded-query exponential separations and auxiliary oblivious/lowness classes, where ordinary class diagrams omit information.
limitations: No individual unreviewed pair is certified open by this audit.
The source search and complete class-entry screens are not an exhaustive literature corpus search.
Known baseline proofs are trusted cited inputs; this report neither formalizes nor re-proves all of them.
Current web pages have no cutoff authority; each imported result requires its primary pre-cutoff source.
Source inspection limits and coarse publication dates are stated separately.
The numeric risk inputs are provisional and need challenge in a distinct review pass.
